blockers.owner: Qualified thermal/electrical engineer with hardware lead
blockers.blocked_claim: The issued HUB can operate at the illustrative35C ambient/peak-load scenario inside its closed enclosure.
blockers.reason: No selected and source-backed or measured enclosure-to-ambient heat path exists. The declared1.5K/W assumption predicts67.786C internal air at peak shade load, above the Pi50C ambient limit. Removing absorbed sun alone does not fix this.
required_design_inputs: Exact enclosure, tray/converter mounting and thermal interfaces
Source-backed heat spreader/sink/ventilation/shade design compatible with ingress/corrosion/service requirements
Actual electronics duty/peak and converter efficiency

measurement_hold_point.test_type: Approved guarded dry dummy-load heat-path characterization; no underwater instruments or acoustic hardware.
measurement_hold_point.specimen: Exact closed enclosure, mounting orientation, passive heat path and proposed shading. Do not use the open CAD cavity as a thermal specimen.
measurement_hold_point.heat_load: Apply a calibrated safe dummy-load distribution representing21.857142857W enclosed heat, then the approved uncertainty/worst-state margin. Reviewer must validate component heat locations and method; this record does not authorize energization.
measurement_hold_point.exposure: Characterize shaded ambient first, then the approved external irradiance/absorption case. A physical shade must be tested or conservatively bounded; do not silently set absorbed solar heat to zero.
instrumentation: Traceably calibrated ambient and internal-air sensors near Pi/DAQ/converter
Selected component case/terminal measurement where required
Measured electrical input heat with uncertainty
Timestamped logging and approved stabilization criterion
measurement_hold_point.acceptance_inequality: At the frozen load and environment, maximum measured local component ambient + expanded uncertainty <= applicable vendor ambient limit. For Pi the current source limit is50C. Also pass every other component, terminal, battery and accessible-surface constraint; a Pi-only pass is insufficient.
measurement_hold_point.effective_rth_equation: (steady internal_air_c - ambient_c) / measured_enclosed_heat_w for the stated setup; treat solar loading separately rather than reporting one universal Rtheta.
freeze_before_test: Separate root/user authorization and safe facility/method
Electrical source/current limit/guarding and abort temperatures
Approved maximum ambient/load/sun cases and sample plan
measurement_hold_point.stop_rule: Qualified operator stops under the approved abort criterion; no unattended or unguarded heater test is authorized. A failed or unperformed test cannot release the reference.

blockers.blocked_claim: The passive reference is ready for energization.
blockers.reason: USB-C source/OVP/current limit, independent REEF regulators, compatible external battery BMS/charge-load disconnect and coordinated wire/fuse/connector parts remain unselected. A steady-state energy pass cannot close these gaps.
close_with: Exact selected components and reviewed wiring/connector/grounding design
Measured inrush/radio burst, fault clearing and low-temperature charging inhibition
Updated approved BOM and assembly instructions before physical build

blockers.owner: Electrical/mechanical engineer with root/user configuration decision
blockers.blocked_claim: The issued one-panel REEF is autonomous under its illustrative1PSH scenario.
blockers.reason: The unchanged40W case has negative energy balance and insufficient modeled hot-panel startup voltage. Comparison cases are analytical candidates, not adopted hardware.
blockers.candidate_boundary: Two series-connected40W reference panels can be screened under the unchanged assumptions. The current1.1 CAD and BOM still contain one panel; no two-panel mounting, wiring, procurement quantity or deployment is released.
close_with: Explicit configuration selection and a new reference revision if panel count/topology changes
Revised frame, wind/load/attachment and cable/connector/protection design
Current source availability and exact module/controller/BMS data
Site-specific worst-season irradiance/shading and measured consumption
Actual cold/hot startup, charging and reserve measurements
